scope: 既存公開23短例のmetadataと現chunk01の照合記録。全長NPYと先頭抜粋PCMのSHAは23/23一致。新規音声生成・アップロードなし。公開URL配信bytes・再生は未確認。
conversion_verbatim: Existing PCM16 samples unchanged: gain 1, rint(x*32767), nearest ties-to-even, little-endian, no dither; no normalization/clipping/resampling/alignment. Public excerpts are the first min(source length, five seconds); full-length WAV bytes are preserved when within the limit.
range_end_convention: end exclusive: range length equals samples; 元raw manifestにexclusiveという明記はないが開始0・終了samplesおよび先頭min(N,5秒)の定義から対応。
missing_or_not_checked: 公開URLの現時点HTTP応答・WAV配信bytes・ブラウザ再生は未確認。実行環境内の照合と配信確認は別。
PML/RAW_FULL全長float64 array単独のSHAは元metadataに未記載。全長NPYファイルSHA一致と混同しない。
5秒に切った9クリップの全長PCM payload SHAは元metadataに未記載。公開する先頭抜粋PCMのSHA一致は確認済み。

attribution.citation: V. Panayotov, G. Chen, D. Povey, S. Khudanpur. LibriSpeech: An ASR Corpus Based on Public Domain Audio Books. ICASSP, 2015.
attribution.upstream_sources: LibriVox audiobook recordings and Project Gutenberg texts
attribution.research_modifications: Fixed source excerpts up to six seconds, PML resynthesis and unseparated high-band envelope transfer. Public listening excerpts retain existing PCM samples, with only first-five-second cropping for longer recordings.
attribution.endorsement: No endorsement by the authors, distributors, readers, or source projects is implied.
